definitions.meaning: To keep holy day, to celebrate

quotations.old_english: Sce. Eádweardes mæssedæg witan habbaþ gecoren, ðæt man freólsian sceal ofer eal Engla land
quotations.english: the witan have chosen, that St. Edward's mass-day should be celebrated over all England

quotations.old_english: Wirc six dagas and freólsa ðone seofoðan
quotations.latin: sex diēbus oprāberis, die septimo cessābis

quotations.old_english: Beó ðú gemyndig ðæt ðú ðone restendæg freólsige
quotations.english: be thou mindful that thou keep holy the day of rest
quotations.citations: Homl. Th. ii. 198, 4: E. Eth. v. 14; Th. i. 308, 15

source_text: freólsian; p. ode; pp. od [freóls a holy day]; v. trans. To keep holy day, to celebrate; celebr&a-long;re diem festum:-- Sce. Eádweardes mæssedæg witan habbaþ gecoren, ðæt man freólsian sceal ofer eal Engla land the witan have chosen, that St. Edward's mass-day should be celebrated over all England, L. Eth. v. 16; Th. i. 308, 21: L. C. E. 17; Th. i. 370, 7. Wirc six dagas and freólsa ðone seofoðan sex di&e-long;bus opr&a-long;beris, die septimo cess&a-long;bis, Ex. 34. 21. Freólsiaþ Drihtnes restedæg sabb&a-short;t&i-long;zes sabb&a-short;tum Domino, Lev. 25, 2. Beó ðú gemyndig ðæt ðú ðone restendæg freólsige be thou mindful that thou keep holy the day of rest, Homl. Th. ii. 198, 4: E. Eth. v. 14; Th. i. 308, 15. [Orm. freollsenn.] DER. ge-freólsian.
